description: Published cross-framework comparison (M7, ADR-0013): the §18 beat workloads, 5-run medians per framework, everything labeled with its measured scope. Regenerate with scripts/run_comparison.py; validate with --validate.

protocol.estimator: median-of-medians (criterion median per run, median across runs)

beat.definition: alacer median < every competitor median on the same host, per workload (§1: beats both egui and the best audited retained stack in at least one shared workload)

alacer.scope: incremental relayout of the churned frame through the persistent taffy tree (layout only — the framework's own published bench)

competitors.scope: full immediate-mode frame: widget walk + layout + galley shaping + tessellation over the whole 10k tree; row virtualization deliberately not taken (mechanism under test — see the project README)

full pass pipeline through redraw(): update + layout + compose + paint-scene build + a11y tree update over the whole 10k tree; vello rasterization excluded (no GPU device on this rig — labeled, conservative)

alacer.scope: incremental text relayout under the ±5% width jitter through the persistent taffy tree (layout only — the framework's own bench)

competitors.scope: full immediate-mode frame at the jittered width: widget walk + layout + galley re-shaping (the galley cache's real behavior) + tessellation; virtualization not taken

full pass pipeline through redraw() at the jittered width: parley re-breaking on changed constraints + layout + paint-scene build + a11y tree update; vello rasterization excluded (labeled, conservative)

alacer.scope: one animation frame through the real ten-pass pipeline INCLUDING the damaged software raster (the framework's own bench)

competitors.scope: full immediate-mode frame: widget walk + per-frame paint ops (1k rects, 10% fading) + tessellation; pixel rasterization excluded (as for every competitor row)
full pass pipeline through redraw() with compose-level transforms on 1k nodes (translation-only path); no fade churn and no vello rasterization (labeled, conservative)
